scenarios.behavior: HMAC signature mismatch detected and rejected

scenarios.behavior: HMAC signature mismatch detected and rejected

scenarios.behavior: HMAC signature mismatch detected and rejected

scenarios.behavior: HMAC signature mismatch detected and rejected

scenarios.name: Invalid signature
scenarios.behavior: Constant-time comparison fails and rejects token

scenarios.name: Unknown signing key ID
scenarios.behavior: UnknownKeyIdError raised; verification fails closed

scenarios.name: Revoked authorization
scenarios.behavior: Store marks REVOKED; immediate gate rejection

scenarios.name: Expired authorization
scenarios.behavior: Expired timestamp checked before execution; rejected

scenarios.name: Missing approval record
scenarios.behavior: Valid token without store approval rejected with MISSING_APPROVAL_RECORD

scenarios.name: Forged approval configuration
scenarios.behavior: Production approval creation strictly prohibited

scenarios.name: Concurrent quota exhaustion
scenarios.behavior: Atomic reservation prevents overspending under multi-threaded races

scenarios.name: Redirect to unapproved domain
scenarios.behavior: Domain security re-evaluates redirect and blocks target

scenarios.name: Direct transport authorization bypass
scenarios.behavior: Direct execute_request blocked by NetworkActivationGate

scenarios.name: Unauthorized trading endpoint
scenarios.behavior: Trading endpoints raise TradingIsolationViolation

scenarios.name: Restart after authorization revocation
scenarios.behavior: Durable SQLite store preserves REVOKED state across process restarts

scenarios.behavior: Revoking key in registry immediately invalidates tokens signed by it
